title: Achitophel
summary: Raleigh names Achitophel in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Achitophel, a reuolted Counsailor, who inflamed Absalom against Dauid and then forsooke his owne life. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVII, §. VII, sig. 296b–297a
